RIQUA [resolve guards]: before every resolve attempt, run wkappbot skill read suggest-resolve-pre-flight-checklist. Covers 5 guards that block resolve: commit keyword, class size under 400 lines, evidence filename cmd-subcmd match, full absolute path, and final command flags.
Use wkappbot eye tick to verify Eye is running and the hot-swap binary is active before and after CDP bug fix resolve

NEW CDP BUG PATTERNS (v7.3) -- know before triaging suggests:
1. Off-screen caller HWND: launcher now rejects explicitly (fail-fast). If suggest filed, verify caller GetWindowRect() returns valid on-screen rect. Use wkappbot skill read standard-appbot-window.
2. Chrome position mismatch after hot-swap: two-layer fix in place (session-restore Preferences patch + post-bounds re-assert via CdpClient.WindowStabilize). If still drifting post-deploy, check cdp-mon for residual BOUNDS:TIMEOUT. Confirm Core v7.3+ running.
3. Caller HWND via process chain: launcher walks ancestors only, NO foreground fallback. If suggest mentions foreground/desktop/console as caller, investigate ResolveCallerTerminalHwnd in MyCdpContext.Placement.cs.
